channels.name: SENT signal
channels.purpose: Single push-pull wire carrying nibble pulses (falling-edge-to-falling-edge tick timing).

global_signals.name: Tick (unit time)
global_signals.purpose: The time base; recovered from the 56-tick calibration pulse each frame.

global_signals.name: Frame
global_signals.purpose: calibration pulse + status + data + CRC (+ optional pause).

global_signals.name: Slow channel
global_signals.purpose: Serial message assembled from status-nibble bit 2/3 across frames.

handshake_pairs.name: Calibration / decode
handshake_pairs.rule: The 56-tick calibration pulse sets the tick time for all nibbles in the frame.

handshake_pairs.name: SPC trigger / response
handshake_pairs.rule: An ECU master trigger pulse elicits a SENT frame (synchronous, addressable).

dependency_graph.common_rule: A nibble cannot be decoded until the receiver has measured the 56-tick synchronization/calibration pulse and recovered the per-frame tick time. Each frame is independent: the calibration pulse re-establishes the tick time.
dependency_graph.data_dependency: A data nibble value = round(period_ticks / tick_time) - 12; the CRC nibble validates the data nibbles; the slow channel accumulates bit 2/3 of the status nibble.

fields.ic_name: Single Edge Nibble Transmission (SENT, SAE J2716)

logical_signaling_levels.name: Calibration pulse
logical_signaling_levels.meaning: 56-tick pulse delimiting a frame and recovering the tick time.

logical_signaling_levels.name: Nibble pulse
logical_signaling_levels.meaning: 12 + value ticks; carries 4 bits of data/status/CRC.

logical_signaling_levels.name: Pause pulse
logical_signaling_levels.meaning: Optional padding to a fixed frame length.

ordering_rules.frame_order: calibration pulse -> status nibble -> data nibbles -> CRC nibble -> optional pause pulse.
ordering_rules.edge_order: each pulse begins with a falling edge; nibble value is the falling-edge-to-falling-edge period minus 12 ticks.
ordering_rules.slow_channel: bit 2/3 of the status nibble accumulate across frames into a Short/Enhanced serial message.

ic_name: Single Edge Nibble Transmission (SENT, SAE J2716)
